content.text:
I submitted **index 27 (Sb fraction 0.855)**, the most Sb-rich composition on the line. Its EQE was 0.043%, the highest of the five I measured. All five EQE measurements were used, plus 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.22 | ~0 |
| 15 | 0.51 | 0.0069 |
| 19 | 0.65 | 0.0116 |
| 23 | 0.78 | 0.0082 |
| 27 | 0.855 | 0.043 |

- **Trend:** EQE generally rises with Sb content, and the Sb-rich end is well ahead of the rest. The one dip is index 23, which is lower than index 19.
- **Structure:** XRD at indices 18 and 23 shows the same rutile-type phase. So the gain at high Sb probably comes from composition within that phase, not from a new phase.
- **Low values overall:** Every EQE is far below 0.1%. The 2.4 eV illumination is probably near or below the band gap of these oxides, so none of the compositions responds strongly.

**Uncertainty:** index 27 is at the edge of the line, so I couldn't check whether EQE peaks there or somewhere nearby. Indices 24–26 were never measured and could be as good or better. With only five points, the peak's exact location is not pinned down.
